text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, succinylcholine chloride is listed by FDA as To Be Discontinued. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC discontinued manufacture with an initial posting date of 2026-07-23. Corvale East has 20.5 days on hand (75 vials) and Corvale General has 26.1 days on hand (106.13 vials) at current usage rates.

Why (FDA record): The label for our current product names Eugia Pharma Specialities Limited as the manufacturing plant. FDA inspection 1301166 at that plant ended on 2026-02-06 and was classified OAI. A Warning Letter was issued to the same plant on 2024-08-15 following an earlier OAI inspection.

Our position: Supply is critically low with no replenishment from the discontinued Fresenius line. The sole remaining labeled manufacturer (Eugia) has a recent OAI classification and prior Warning Letter. Alternative suppliers are not on FDA's shortage list but their manufacturing plants are unidentified on labels.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to qualify and purchase from BE Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Baxter Healthcare Corporation — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Camber Pharmaceuticals, Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
4. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Civica, Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
5. Buyer to qualify and purchase from Devatis, Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending further FDA updates given current days-on-hand and the To Be Discontinued status.
